check.dropNote: THE FILE STAYS IN THE BROWSER — ONLY THE FINGERPRINT GOES TO THE SERVER
check.dropTitle: Drag the signed document here or pick a file
check.failed: Could not check the signature. Try again later.
check.found: The document is signed in SuperApp6. Signatures found: {count}
check.lead: Upload the signed document — the browser computes its fingerprint and finds the signatures.
check.leadNote: The file itself is never sent to the server.
check.needsHttps: The check works only over a secure connection (https). Open the page at its https address.
check.notFound: No signatures were found for this document. The file may have been changed after the signing — a single added space is enough for the fingerprint to stop matching.
check.pepNote: Simple electronic signature: the identity is confirmed by the sign-in and by an SMS code, and the integrity of the document is maintained by the information system (art. 46–47 of the Digital Code of the Republic of Kazakhstan).
check.readFailed: Could not read the file or reach the verification service.
check.rowStatus: Status at the moment of signing
check.stampedNotice: You are checking a copy with the stamps. The signatures were placed under the original document — its fingerprint is shown below; the stamped copy itself was made by the system after the signing.
check.thirdPartyNote: The signature containers and the receipts can be checked independently — on the eGov portal, for example.
check.title: Electronic signature check

consent.pd:
I give my consent to {holder} and to the operator of the SuperApp6 information system to collect and process my personal data (surname, first name, patronymic, phone number and, when signing with a QES, the IIN) required to sign this document and to keep the evidence of the signing.

The consent is given for the retention period of the signed document and may be withdrawn in the manner prescribed by the law of the Republic of Kazakhstan.
consent.pep:
I confirm that I have read the document «{docTitle}»{org} and that I sign it with a simple electronic signature.

The parties have agreed that a simple electronic signature — a one-time code sent to a confirmed phone number after signing in to SuperApp6 — is equivalent to a handwritten signature (art. 46–47 of the Digital Code of the Republic of Kazakhstan, art. 152 of the Civil Code of the Republic of Kazakhstan).

The integrity of the signed document is maintained by the SuperApp6 information system: the document fingerprint (SHA-256), the time of signing and the action log are stored.
